description: NaFeSnO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-56°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.11 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-57°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.09 Å. There are two inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-57°. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.12 Å. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-56°. There are two shorter (2.09 Å) and four longer (2.12 Å) Sn-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and two equivalent Sn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂FeSn₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Fe, and one Sn atom to form distorted ONa₂Fe₂Sn trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂Sn square pyramids, corners with three ONa₂FeSn₂ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Fe₂Sn square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂FeSn₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and two equivalent Sn atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Fe, and one Sn atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and two equivalent Sn atoms to form distorted ONa₂FeSn₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂FeSn₂ square pyramids, corners with seven ONa₂FeSn₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂FeSn₂ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂Sn trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Fe, and one Sn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Fe₂Sn trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Fe, and two equivalent Sn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂FeSn₂ square pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Fe, and one Sn atom to form ONa₂Fe₂Sn square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂Fe₂Sn trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₂FeSn₂ square pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂Fe₂Sn trigonal bipyramids.
